Stop! Libra, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Saturn is forming a sextile to your Ascendant in the 1st House while Mercury opposes Neptune in the 2nd House, blending clarity with a foggy financial outlook now and brings a stabilizing effect on your finances, influencing your Air element.
Mars squares your ruling planet Venus in the 7th House, stirring heated debates and pull‑to‑pull romance with dramatic intensity.
If you’re single, you’ll attract intense but fleeting chemistry that demands you stay grounded and aware.
For those partnered, expect power struggles that dissolve once you both pause and listen calmly.
The Saturn sextile gives you steady resolve at work, boosting productivity and confidence, but Mercury’s opposition to Neptune warns against impulsive investments; trust numbers over intuition now.
Avoid making any big financial decisions under the Neptune mist, or you could lose hard‑earned stability.
Follow for tomorrow's reading.
